description: Everything the Companion window may invoke. Tauri denies by default, so this list is the whole surface: adding a capability here is a deliberate act, which is the property we chose Tauri for.

permissions.description: Open a block-explorer link (a Zcash transaction) in the system browser. Both webviews drop target=_blank, so without this an explorer link is a link that does nothing. Scoped to https so the window cannot hand the OS a file:// or a custom scheme. The only URLs the app passes are built by the app itself (explorerTx in packages/core/src/zcash.ts).
